categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the 'RPC/REST/ZMQ' label, modifies the HTTP server in 'src/httpserver.cpp', and updates the HTTP functional test in 'test/functional/interface_http.py'.
categories.rationale: Fixes an intermittent CI test failure in 'interface_http.py' by logging received bytes in the HTTP server and rewriting the receive-throttle test to poll server logs instead of relying on flaky socket heuristics (#36216). This resolves test flakiness on macOS without altering public interfaces or production RPC behavior.
